profile.subtitle: The employee's goals across review cycles

templates.description: What a review rates: the scale, the competencies and how much goals weigh. A cycle keeps a copy from its launch, so a change reaches only cycles launched after it.
templates.hint: Every review in a cycle using this template rates these competencies, and the employee's goals.
templates.scaleHint: Ratings run from 1 to this, between 3 and 10.
templates.goalsWeightHint: The share of the overall score goals carry; competencies carry the rest.
templates.weightHint: A competency with no weight counts as much as the others.

problems.competency: Give every competency a code (letters, digits, dashes) and an Arabic name.

cycles.description: Every review cycle, latest period first. A cycle is launched and then moved one phase at a time on its own page.
cycles.hint: Launching it opens a review for everyone it covers, with their manager as reviewer.
cycles.notFound: This review cycle does not exist.
cycles.draftHint: A draft: launch it to open a review for everyone it covers.

confirm.goal_setting: Launch this cycle? A review opens for everyone it covers today, their manager as reviewer, and goal setting begins. It can no longer be edited.
confirm.self_review: Move to self review? Goals' titles and weights become fixed, and every employee is told to fill in their self review.
confirm.manager_review: Move to manager review? Self reviews close, and every reviewer is told to rate their reviews.
confirm.calibration: Move to calibration? Manager reviews close; rated reviews can then be calibrated.
confirm.closed: Close this cycle? Every review is finalized with its calibrated score, or else its reviewer's score, and employees can read their result. This cannot be undone.

cycles.addEmployeeHint: Someone the launch did not include — hired since, or moved into the unit. Their manager becomes the reviewer.

reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.recommendationHint: A suggestion only; a promotion or pay change is still recorded by HR.
reviews.calibrateHint: Sets the score the final rating comes from, between 1 and {max}.
reviews.selfHint: Rate yourself on each item from 1 to {max}. You may leave some unrated.
reviews.managerHint: Rate {name} on every item from 1 to {max}. What they said is shown beside each.
reviews.submitConfirm: Send it? It can no longer change once sent.

goals.title: Goals
goals.description: Every goal, by employee, cycle and status. Choose an employee to set a goal for them.
goals.weightHint: A cycle's goals weigh 100 at most together.
goals.lockedHint: The cycle has left goal setting: only progress and status can change.
goals.pickEmployee: Choose an employee to set a goal for them.

mine.description: Your goals and reviews, and, as a manager, your team's goals and the reviews you conduct.
